subject: SIG / SOC2: RTO & RPO timing matrix + live witness scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorafin.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO timing matrix + live witness

Hi Michael,

Aurora's audit team is working through the SIG/SOC2 continuity sections and we need a compact evidence package covering RTO/RPO for the inference endpoints we rely on. Can you provide the following by end of week?

- A timing matrix (CSV/XLSX) showing measured warm-failover and cold-start RTOs and RPOs for the last two quarterly tests by region.
- KV cache warm-up timings and an example trace for a 60-second warmup window.
- A short failover sequence summary describing steps the ops team executes (who runs what, expected manual/automated steps).
- Availability of a 60–90 minute live witness session (screen-share + runbook walkthrough) next week for Aurora auditors.

We'd like artifacts that map to SIG questions CP-02/03 and SOC2 CC7.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director, IT Risk
Aurora Finance

Attachment: n/a

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO timing matrix + live witness

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a concise packet and can host a live witness. Quick clarifications so we scope the artifacts correctly:

1) Which Redwood endpoints are in scope? My guess is the hosted inference API endpoints (text generation + embeddings) for production-us-west and dedicated-us-east pools. Confirm if you need private/VPC snapshots as well.
2) For "last two quarterly tests" do you need the actual telemetry extracts, or a reconciled summary (timing matrix + sample traces)? Telemetry extracts contain large logs; we can provide samples and a reconciled spreadsheet.

Plan: Neha will prepare the timing matrix and a representative kv warmup trace; Ben will prepare the failover sequence PDF and high-level ops runbook. I'll propose two windows for the witness session next week.

Proposed witness slots: Tue 07/06 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 07/08 13:00–14:30 PT. Please confirm preferred slot and scope.

Michael Grant
Sr. Manager, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorafin.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO timing matrix + live witness

Hi Samir / Mike — attaching the artifacts below and summarizing key numbers. See attachments: rto_rpo_timing_matrix.xlsx, kv_warmup_trace.log, failover_sequence_summary.pdf. (Attachments are redacted samples suitable for auditors.)

Summary (production-us-west / dedicated-us-east):
- Measured RTO (warm failover, last quarterly test): 4m 20s median, 8m 10s 95th percentile.
- Cold-start RTO (full cold restore from snapshot): 2h 10m typical for offsite cold-restore path; warm standby reduces to the 4–8 minute range.
- RPO: <5 minutes typical (KV replication across regions with async replication + commit log).
- KV cache warmup: sample trace shows 45–70s to reach 90% of steady-state hit rate under synthetic replay. Trace attached (kv_warmup_trace.log).

Failover sequence highlights (see PDF for step-by-step):
1) Traffic drain and redirect to secondary region via Smart Router (automated).
2) Warm cache pre-warm using prefix replay (semi-automated orchestration).
3) Health probes and live-sanity checks (manual sign-off from on-call).
4) Promote secondary endpoints and roll back DNS/edge rules (automated + audit logs).

We sanitized the traces to hide token-level payloads; telemetry IDs and timestamps are preserved for audit correlation.

If Aurora needs the full telemetry extracts, we'll raise an evidence transfer request and coordinate an S3 share with strict access controls.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rto_rpo_timing_matrix.xlsx (xls/xlsx stub), kv_warmup_trace.log (text), failover_sequence_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorafin.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO timing matrix + live witness

Michael / Neha — this looks good, thanks for the quick turnaround. The summarized numbers and the attached trace are sufficient for our SIG review.

We'd like to confirm the witness slot for Thu 07/08 13:00–14:30 PT. Agenda: 1) runbook walkthrough + live failover play (dry-run screenshots), 2) review of timing matrix and traces, 3) short Q&A on data sanitization / retention. Please share the call link and the Drive location for the attachments (we'll link them in the audit ticket).

Couple of small asks before the session:
- If possible, include a short table of recovery owners (names + roles + contact) in the runbook PDF.
- Add the last-executed test timestamp (we need exact test dates for the SIG evidence cell).

If you can confirm A) witness link, B) Drive link, and C) an updated runbook that lists owners and test timestamp by tomorrow EOD, we'll be set.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, IT Risk
Aurora Finance
